description: This file defines custom stringer implementations for protobuf messages related to etcd's Raft internal requests, including redacting sensitive information and replacing value bytes with size fields for logging purposes.

classes.name: InternalRaftStringer
classes.description: Implements custom proto Stringer to redact passwords and replace value fields with size fields.

classes.name: txnRequestStringer
classes.description: Implements fmt.Stringer to replace value bytes with size fields in nested transactions.

classes.name: requestOpStringer
classes.description: Implements custom proto Stringer for request operations, redacting or replacing value bytes.

classes.name: loggableValueCompare
classes.description: Custom proto String for Compare.Value union member, replacing value bytes with size.

classes.name: loggablePutRequest
classes.description: Custom proto Message replacing value bytes with size for PutRequest.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a formatted string with redacted or summarized request info.

methods.name: NewLoggableTxnRequest
methods.description: Creates a loggable version of a TxnRequest with value sizes.

methods.name: newLoggableRequestOp
methods.description: Creates a loggable version of a RequestOp with redacted or summarized info.

methods.name: newLoggableValueCompare
methods.description: Creates a loggable Compare object with value size.

methods.name: NewLoggablePutRequest
methods.description: Creates a loggable PutRequest with value size.
